instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Set up Tailwind v4 theme tokens in frontend/src/index.css with dark theme variables and fonts (@fontsource-variable/space-grotesk and @fontsource-variable/plus-jakarta-sans).
2. Implement full Spanish (es) and English (en) dictionary in frontend/src/lib/i18n.ts with seamless language toggle persisted in localStorage.
3. Implement live restaurant status engine in frontend/src/lib/openingHours.ts checking Europe/Madrid timezone time against Thu 19:00-00:00, Fri-Sun 19:00-01:00, Mon-Wed Closed.
4. Implement Booking validation ensuring users can only pick open days (Thu-Sun) and allowed timeslots (19:00 to 23:30).
5. Ensure all forms validate inputs and provide immediate visual feedback with toast notifications using Sonner.
6. Build backend API endpoints with FastAPI (FastAPI router with prefix /api) + MongoDB for bookings, contact messages, and menu items with seed data preloaded.

7. Include default menu items: Montecarlo Burger (180g beef, Takis, chicken thigh), Smokey BBQ Wings, Spicy Mango Habanero Wings, Fresh Salmon Poké, Crispy Chicken Poké, Loaded Bacon Cheese Nachos, Truffle Fries, Lotus Biscoff Cheesecake, Artisan Brownie.
8. Implement Admin panel at /admin with secure PIN verification (default 1234), quick stats, bookings manager (confirm/cancel/filter), inbox reader, and menu toggle.
9. Add floating mobile action bar on mobile viewports (<768px) with Call, Book Table, and View Menu buttons for high Instagram conversion.
10. Ensure data-testid is attached to every button, link, input, tab, and card element.
